subject: SBuild 2026: Customer panel invite — Scaling LLMs in Production
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@rapidscale.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SBuild 2026: Customer panel invite — Scaling LLMs in Production

Hi Anna,

I hope you and the RapidScale team are doing well. We're pulling together a short customer panel for SBuild on Sept 14 (45 minutes total) called "Scaling LLMs in Production: Cost, Latency, and Tradeoffs." We'd love to have RapidScale join as a featured customer to talk through the deployment story you and your infra team shipped this spring.

High-level ask: one product/infra speaker (15 min speaking + 10 min panel Q&A). We'll use the remaining slot for a brief Redwood product demo and moderated discussion. We think RapidScale's experience with quantized models and traffic-tier routing would resonate with the audience.

Logistics we can cover: travel stipend or honorarium, a short pre-event prep call, and a slide review. I've attached a 1-page speaker brief and a suggested case summary template to this thread.

Would you be open to participating? If yes, can you share a preferred speaker name and any scheduling constraints this quarter?

Thank you — we value RapidScale as a customer and think this would be a great spotlight for your team.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sbuild_speaker_brief.pdf, rapidscale_case_summary.pdf
From: Anna Lopez <anna@rapidscale.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: RapidScale Events <events@rapidscale.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SBuild 2026: Customer panel invite — Scaling LLMs in Production

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the invite and for thinking of RapidScale. We'd be happy to participate; this topic aligns well with what we've been presenting internally. A few quick notes: 

- Speaker: I can do this, but I'd prefer to bring Marco Hernandez (our Head of Infrastructure) if he's available — he'll be better on technical tradeoffs and quantization wins.
- Format: The 15+10 split works. We might want 20 minutes for Marco if possible (we have a short demo to show).
- Compensation: Does Redwood offer an honorarium or travel stipend? We typically confirm after that.
- Prep: A 30–45 minute prep call 2 weeks prior is ideal; Marco prefers afternoon PST.

Attach: I included a short RapidScale speaker bio and a draft of the slides we'll likely use (just placeholders).

Let me know next steps and any deadlines for copy/approvals.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Director, Product at RapidScale AI
anna@rapidscale.ai

Subject: Fwd: SBuild 2026: Customer panel invite — RapidScale interest (logistics)

Vivek / Marissa — Anna is open to participating and suggests bringing Marco Hernandez (Head of Infrastructure). She also asked about honorarium/travel. Can we confirm our standard offer for SBuild and any limits on speaker time (they asked for 20 minutes)?

Proposal: Offer $1,500 honorarium (or travel stipend up to $1,000) + covered hotel night in SF, 30–45 min prep call 2 weeks prior, and slide review. If Marco needs 20 minutes, we can expand the slot to 50 minutes total and shorten the Redwood demo to 5–7 minutes. Thoughts?

Next steps: if approved I can send a short agreement and calendar invite (DocuSign + calendar link). Marissa, can you add this to our events tracker and draft a speaker brief for Marco? Vivek — need approval on the honorarium.

Thanks,
Kimberly
